method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: One inked row, 571. Form A's printed TOTAL reads 571 and equals BOTH cover line-1 THIS (571) and CUMULATIVE (571); the 'Totals from Last Report' column is blank on every line, so this is the filer's first report of the cycle and the two scopes coincide. Cover line 2 (aggregate of $50.00 or less) is blank in all three columns, so line1 alone is the correct anchor and there is no small-donor residue.

expenditures.detail: One inked row, 571. Form B printed TOTAL 571 = cover line-3 THIS = cover line-3 CUMULATIVE (first report of cycle, scopes coincide).

gates.page_subtotal: p2 rows sum 571 = printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS 571 (exact); p3 rows sum 571 = printed TOTAL EXPENDITURES 571 (exact). Both totals re-read in 600 dpi crops of the footer cell.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p2 reports 13 usable bands (the scan is wavy, so rule detection drops the upper grid — 'gaps' status, not an oracle); ink counted by eye on the 200 dpi page = exactly 1 written row, the rest of the ~40-row grid empty. p3 rowbands 21 bands, 1 inked row by eye. 1 row emitted per side.
gates.geometry_proof: p2: crop pct:72.33,13.20,11.16,2.00 renders '$ 571' (row 1 amount); control one pitch below (y 15.20%) renders an empty ruled cell with only the printed '$'. p3: crop pct:71.43,14.30,12.00,2.00 renders '$ 571'; control one pitch below renders empty. Both pass.
gates.balance_chain: Cover line 4 (balance at end of period) CUMULATIVE cell holds a single written zero glyph; 0 + 571 - 571 = 0 closes exactly.

escalation_note: 600-900 dpi cell crops: p2 amount cell, p2 TOTAL footer, p2 name+address band, p3 amount cell, p3 TOTAL footer, p3 vendor and purpose cells; plus a 400 dpi crop of the cover money grid.
notes: index.csv/chunk file call this Slade Rudy Hughes, Commission Seat C, 2020 — the cover's 'Full Name of Candidate' reads 'Slade Rudy Hughes' and 'Office' reads 'County Commission Seat C'; agrees. Certification period 3-19-2020 to 4-20-2020, signed 4-20-2020. Both schedule rows are the candidate self-funding the filing fee. Form A's Mailing Address cell holds ONLY a ZIP (no city/state), so donor_city/donor_state are honestly blank and the ZIP is discarded at read time per privacy. The Gen-2 'In Kind?' column exists on Form A and the filer left it EMPTY — a blank is not an 'N', recorded as in_kind:false with the blank noted. Scan is a CamScanner capture with pronounced page waviness (rules bow ~2% across the width); geometry boxes were proved by crop rather than trusted from rowbands.
